intro: IHC produced a creator led olympic-style digital campaign for lionsgate's latest Hunger Games Movie.

introPieces.html:
This creative digital campaign took inspiration from iconic Olympic Games posters - bold geometric forms and institutional prestige - reimagined through the lens of Capitol propaganda.

We collaborated with 6 creators who specialize in design to create a poster series positioned as capital propaganda to live across social media.

Our creators included Renographics, Catarina Agostinho, Ricardo Cavolo, Alex Khabbazi, Elijah Jambalaya, & Kody.
